title: KPN focus group Nov. 9: representing single-cell data
summary: Please join us on Thursday, November 9 for our next KPN focus group, featuring Dr. Kyle Gaulton of the University of California, San Diego.
bodyHtml: If you missed our Knowledge Portal Network focus group with Dr. Kyle Gaulton, you can see the recording here. Please take a look and give us your feedback on ways in which you would like to visualize, filter, and query these data! Contact us at help@kp4cd.org.
